mapper.select: SELECT i.invoice_id AS id, i.invoice_no AS bill_no, i.supplier_id AS partner_id, i.supplier_name AS partner_name, i.invoice_amount AS amount_excl_tax, i.tax_amount AS tax_amount, i.total_amount AS total_amount, i.invoice_date AS bill_date FROM pms_invoice i WHERE i.status = '2' AND i.del_flag = '0' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fin_voucher v WHERE v.source_module = 'pms' AND v.source_type = 'invoice' AND v.source_id = i.invoice_id AND v.del_flag = '0' ) ORDER BY i.invoice_date, i.invoice_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.shipment_id AS shipment_id, s.shipment_no AS shipment_no, s.order_id AS order_id, s.contract_id AS contract_id, s.customer_id AS customer_id, s.customer_name AS customer_name, s.total_amount AS total_amount, s.total_qty AS total_qty, s.shipment_date AS shipment_date FROM mk_shipment s WHERE s.status = '1' AND s.del_flag = '0' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fin_voucher v WHERE v.source_module = 'mk' AND v.source_type = 'shipment' AND v.source_id = s.shipment_id AND v.del_flag = '0' ) ORDER BY s.shipment_date, s.shipment_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT b.batch_id AS batch_id, b.batch_no AS batch_no, b.`year_month` AS `year_month`, b.pay_date AS pay_date, b.total_count AS total_count, b.total_amount AS total_amount, b.bank_name AS bank_name, b.bank_receipt_no AS bank_receipt_no FROM biz_hr_payroll_batch b WHERE b.audit_status = '3' AND b.del_flag = '0' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fin_voucher v WHERE v.source_module = 'hr' AND v.source_type = 'payroll' AND v.source_id = b.batch_id AND v.del_flag = '0' ) ORDER BY b.pay_date, b.batch_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.supplier_id AS id, s.supplier_code AS bill_no, s.supplier_name AS partner_name, s.payment_days AS payment_days, s.settlement_type AS settlement_type FROM wms_supplier s WHERE s.supplier_id = #{supplierId} AND s.del_flag = '0'
SELECT m.material_id AS id, m.material_code AS material_code, m.material_name AS material_name FROM wms_material m WHERE m.material_code = #{materialCode} AND m.del_flag = '0'

SELECT d.detail_id AS detail_id, o.order_id AS inbound_order_id, o.order_no AS inbound_order_no, o.inbound_date AS inbound_date, o.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id, d.material_id AS material_id, m.material_code AS material_code, m.material_name AS material_name, IFNULL(d.batch_no, '') AS batch_no, IFNULL(d.location_id, 0) AS location_id, IFNULL(d.received_qty, 0) AS received_qty, d.unit_price AS unit_price FROM wms_inbound_order_detail d JOIN wms_inbound_order o ON o.order_id = d.order_id AND o.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN wms_material m ON m.material_id = d.material_id WHERE o.status = '3' AND d.del_flag = '0' AND d.received_qty > 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fin_inventory_cost c WHERE c.material_id = d.material_id AND c.warehouse_id = o.warehouse_id AND c.location_id = IFNULL(d.location_id, 0) AND c.batch_no = IFNULL(d.batch_no, '') AND c.inbound_order_id = o.order_id AND c.del_flag = '0' ) ORDER BY o.inbound_date, d.detail_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT d.detail_id AS detail_id, o.order_id AS outbound_order_id, o.order_no AS outbound_order_no, o.order_type AS order_type, o.outbound_date AS outbound_date, o.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id, d.material_id AS material_id, m.material_code AS material_code, m.material_name AS material_name, IFNULL(d.batch_no, '') AS batch_no, IFNULL(d.location_id, 0) AS location_id, IFNULL(d.actual_qty, 0) AS actual_qty FROM wms_outbound_order_detail d JOIN wms_outbound_order o ON o.order_id = d.order_id AND o.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN wms_material m ON m.material_id = d.material_id WHERE o.status = '3' AND d.del_flag = '0' AND d.actual_qty > 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fin_cost_carry_forward cf WHERE cf.source_module = 'wms' AND cf.source_type = 'outbound' AND cf.source_id = d.detail_id AND cf.del_flag = '0' ) ORDER BY o.outbound_date, d.detail_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT i.invoice_id AS invoice_id, i.invoice_no AS invoice_no, NULL AS invoice_code, i.invoice_date AS invoice_date, i.supplier_id AS supplier_id, i.supplier_name AS supplier_name, i.invoice_amount AS invoice_amount, i.tax_amount AS tax_amount, i.total_amount AS total_amount, IFNULL(i.payment_amount, 0) AS payment_amount, IFNULL(i.tax_rate, 0) / 100 AS tax_rate, IFNULL(s.payment_days, 0) AS payment_days, p.partner_id AS partner_id FROM pms_invoice i LEFT JOIN wms_supplier s ON s.supplier_id = i.supplier_id AND s.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fin_partner p ON p.source_module = 'wms' AND p.source_id = i.supplier_id AND p.del_flag = '0' WHERE i.status = '2' AND i.del_flag = '0' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fin_ap_order a WHERE a.source_module = 'pms' AND a.source_type = 'invoice' AND a.source_id = i.invoice_id AND a.del_flag = '0' ) ORDER BY i.invoice_date, i.invoice_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.shipment_id AS shipment_id, s.shipment_no AS shipment_no, s.shipment_date AS shipment_date, s.customer_id AS customer_id, s.customer_name AS customer_name, IFNULL(s.total_amount, 0) AS total_amount, IFNULL(p.payment_days, 0) AS payment_days, p.partner_id AS partner_id FROM mk_shipment s LEFT JOIN fin_partner p ON p.source_module = 'mk' AND p.source_id = s.customer_id AND p.del_flag = '0' WHERE s.status IN ('2', '3', '4') AND s.del_flag = '0' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fin_ar_order a WHERE a.source_module = 'mk' AND a.source_type = 'shipment' AND a.source_id = s.shipment_id AND a.del_flag = '0' ) ORDER BY s.shipment_date, s.shipment_id LIMIT #{limit}
